rewritten_query:
WITH target_month AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-04-16'
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN target_month tm ON d.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
    WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN target_month tm ON d.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN target_month tm ON d.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
)
SELECT ss.item_id,
       ss.birth_year,
       ss.ss_item_rev,
       ss.ss_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs.cs_item_rev,
       cs.cs_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws.ws_item_rev,
       ws.ws_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS ws_dev,
       (ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0 AS average
FROM ss_items ss
JOIN cs_items cs
  ON ss.item_id = cs.item_id
 AND ss.birth_year = cs.birth_year
JOIN ws_items ws
  ON ss.item_id = ws.item_id
 AND ss.birth_year = ws.birth_year
WHERE GREATEST(ss.ss_item_rev, cs.cs_item_rev, ws.ws_item_rev)
      <= 1.1 * LEAST(ss.ss_item_rev, cs.cs_item_rev, ws.ws_item_rev)
ORDER BY ss.item_id, ss.birth_year, ss.ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The repeated nested date_dim subquery (d_date IN (... d_month_seq = (...))) in each CTE causes three extra seq scans of date_dim plus three hash semi-joins. It is replaced by a single materialized one-row CTE (target_month) and a direct join on d_month_seq, allowing use of idx_date_dim_month_seq and index probing of the fact tables.

Implicit comma-style joins in all three CTEs and the outer query were rewritten as explicit ANSI JOINs with clear join keys, improving readability and giving the optimizer explicit equi-join conditions.

The six pairwise ratio predicates (each pair checked in both directions) are equivalent, for non-negative revenue sums (guaranteed in TPC-DS ext_sales_price), to a single condition: GREATEST(ss,cs,ws) <= 1.1 * LEAST(ss,cs,ws). This is mathematically identical to requiring every pair's max/min ratio to be within [1, 1.1].

The three channel CTEs are kept because they correctly pre-aggregate each channel before the small final join. MATERIALIZED on target_month guarantees the date lookup is computed exactly once instead of per branch.
